# CenterPoint Association Management

> Community association management for condominium, HOA, and townhome associations in Chicago and the surrounding suburbs of Illinois.

CenterPoint Association Management serves association boards and owners. It does not manage rental apartments or tenant leasing. Office: 5107 N Western Ave, Suite 1S, Chicago, IL 60625. Phone: 773.728.0652. Email: service@centerpointmgmt.com. Resale and lender requests: sales@centerpointmgmt.com.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://centerpointmgmt.com/)
- [Services](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services)
- [Condominium Management](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/condominium-management): Full-service management under the Illinois Condo Act
- [HOA Management](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/hoa-management): Assessments, grounds, and covenant enforcement
- [Townhome Management](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/townhome-management): Shared roofs, exteriors, and common areas
- [High-Rise Management](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/high-rise-condominium-management): Building systems, staff, and vendor oversight
- [Small Condo Associations](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/small-condo-association-management): Right-sized management for smaller buildings
- [Financial Management](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/financial-management): Budgets, reserves, collections, monthly reports
- [Maintenance Coordination](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/maintenance-coordination): Preventive care, competitive bids, emergencies
- [Board Support](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/board-support): Meetings, minutes, and governance guidance
- [Violation Management](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/violation-management): Fair, documented rule enforcement
- [Resale disclosures and lender requests](https://centerpointmgmt.com/services/resale-disclosures)
- [Pricing](https://centerpointmgmt.com/pricing)
- [Service areas](https://centerpointmgmt.com/service-areas)
- [Chicago](https://centerpointmgmt.com/property-management-chicago)
- [North Shore and suburbs](https://centerpointmgmt.com/property-management-north-shore)
- [Proposal scorecard](https://centerpointmgmt.com/tools/compare-management-proposals): free weighted comparison tool
- [Board toolkit](https://centerpointmgmt.com/board-toolkit): RFP outline, interview questions, transition checklist
- [AI information sheet](https://centerpointmgmt.com/ai-info)

## Board guides

- [Governance & Illinois Law](https://centerpointmgmt.com/blog/topic/board-governance-illinois-law): Meetings, elections, notices, records, and the statutes that govern Illinois condominium, HOA, and townhome boards.
- [Finance & Reserves](https://centerpointmgmt.com/blog/topic/association-finance-reserves): Budgets, reserves, assessments, disclosures, collections, insurance, and financial reporting for association boards.
- [Building Operations](https://centerpointmgmt.com/blog/topic/building-operations-capital-planning): Maintenance, capital projects, life safety, facade programs, and vendor oversight for Chicago-area buildings.
- [Choosing Management](https://centerpointmgmt.com/blog/topic/choosing-association-management): How boards evaluate, compare, and switch condominium and HOA management companies.
